name: annas-mcp
description: Search books with Anna's Archive and papers and dissertations with OpenAlex, then download or read the selected work.
long_description: Search books, textbooks, manuals and standards through Anna's Archive. Discover papers and dissertations through OpenAlex by title, author, topic, DOI or OpenAlex work ID, inspect available copies and versions, and download a selected file or read structured full text. Configure an OpenAlex API key for open research, an Anna's Archive membership for archive access, or both for fallback. OpenAlex hosted content consumes its account allowance. The bundle downloads and verifies the matching release binary on first use and saves credentials only in client configuration and provider sessions.

tools.name: book_search
tools.description: Find books, textbooks, manuals and standards in Anna's Archive with format, language, source and year filters

tools.name: article_search
tools.description: Find papers and dissertations by keywords, citation, DOI or OpenAlex ID; return access evidence and arguments for the selected download

tools.name: article_details
tools.description: Inspect a selected paper or dissertation, its abstract, identifiers, versions and available PDF locations

tools.name: article_read
tools.description: Read bounded sections of OpenAlex structured full text, with provenance and continuation; may consume content allowance

tools.name: metadata_search
tools.description: Search library catalogs such as Open Library, WorldCat and ISBNdb for editions and ISBNs

tools.name: book_details
tools.description: Show a book or archive file's identifiers, edition, description and reported problems

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Inspect Anna's membership and download allowance or OpenAlex usage and rate limits

tools.name: book_download
tools.description: Download the selected Anna's Archive file by hash or book-page URL

tools.name: article_download
tools.description: Download a selected paper or dissertation by DOI, OpenAlex work ID or Anna's hash, with eligible provider fallback

secret_key.title: Anna's Archive secret key (optional)
secret_key.description: Anna's Archive account secret key. Required for archive operations. OpenAlex research access uses its own optional key.

download_path.title: Download folder
download_path.description: Where downloaded files are saved. The default, annas-archive in your home folder, needs no extra macOS permission.

account_cookie.title: Account cookie (optional)
account_cookie.description: Leave empty. Only needed if signing in with the secret key fails: the aa_account_id2 cookie from a signed-in browser.

openalex_api_key.title: OpenAlex API key (optional)
openalex_api_key.description: OpenAlex key for paper and dissertation discovery, open PDFs and structured text. Hosted file requests use the OpenAlex account allowance.
